nodes.description: Public address state variable set to msg.sender in the constructor and referenced by the onlyOwner access control check.
Public uint counter that indexes bank records and is incremented at the end of setUser.
Public mapping(uint=>Bank) holding user bank records written by setUser and mutated by withdraw and cal_intrest.
Mapping(uint=>uint) rate table written by setRate and read by setUser, withdraw and cal_intrest.
Constructor that sets owner = msg.sender, id = 1 and emits the deployed event.
Public function that validates inputs, creates a bank record for msg.sender under the current id and increments id.
onlyOwner function that writes the rate table for each asset type and emits the rates event.
onlyOwner function that computes interest as rate*cycle*amount/(100*12) and marks the record matured/withdrawn.
onlyOwner function that recomputes interest as rate*cycle*amount/(100*12) for an existing record.
Caller controlled address used for ownership assignment and for the onlyOwner authorization check.
require(msg.sender == owner) inside the onlyOwner modifier; sole authorization gate on privileged functions.
Unchecked id += 1 in setUser; counter arithmetic with no overflow protection (Solidity <0.8).
Unchecked multiplication _rate*cycle*amount/(100*12) in withdraw; overflow possible with attacker/owner supplied values.
Unchecked multiplication _rate*cycle*amount/(100*12) in cal_intrest; overflow possible.
Parameter of setUser, stored into the record cycle field and used in interest math.
Parameter of setUser, validated to be >= 100 and stored in the record.
Parameter of setUser used as the index into the rate mapping.
Parameter of setUser stored as the record amount and used in interest math.
Parameter of setRate written into rate[AGCoin].
Parameter of setRate written into rate[ETH].
Parameter of setRate written into rate[BTC].
Parameter of setRate written into rate[LTC].
Parameter of setRate written into rate[XRP].
Parameter of setRate written into rate[USD].
Parameter of withdraw used to select the user_details record to settle.
Parameter of withdraw stored as the record withdrawal asset type.
Parameter of cal_intrest used to select the user_details record to recompute.
Local _rate in setUser read from the rate mapping via _v_asset.
Local _rate in withdraw read from user_details[_id].rate.
Local _rate in cal_intrest read from user_details[_id].rate.

normalization_plan.reason: _cycle is a setUser parameter whose only role is feeding the setUser record, so it collapses into the setUser function node.
_asset_value_USD is a setUser parameter validated and stored only by setUser, so it collapses into the setUser function node.
_v_asset is a setUser parameter used only to index the rate mapping inside setUser, so it collapses into the setUser function node.
_amount is a setUser parameter stored only in the setUser record, so it collapses into the setUser function node.
agcoin_rate is a setRate parameter written only into rate[AGCoin] by setRate, so it collapses into the setRate function node.
eth_rate is a setRate parameter written only into rate[ETH] by setRate, so it collapses into the setRate function node.
btc_rate is a setRate parameter written only into rate[BTC] by setRate, so it collapses into the setRate function node.
ltc_rate is a setRate parameter written only into rate[LTC] by setRate, so it collapses into the setRate function node.
xrp_rate is a setRate parameter written only into rate[XRP] by setRate, so it collapses into the setRate function node.
usd_rate is a setRate parameter written only into rate[USD] by setRate, so it collapses into the setRate function node.
_id in withdraw is used only to select the record settled by withdraw, so it collapses into the withdraw function node.
withdrawAsset is a withdraw parameter stored only in the settled record, so it collapses into the withdraw function node.
_id in cal_intrest is used only to select the record recomputed by cal_intrest, so it collapses into the cal_intrest function node.
Local _rate in setUser is a single-use temp for the rate lookup, so it merges into the setUser function node.
Local _rate in withdraw exists only to feed the interest multiplication, so it merges into the withdraw_interest_calc unsafe operation.
Local _rate in cal_intrest exists only to feed the interest multiplication, so it merges into the cal_intrest_interest_calc unsafe operation.
